response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(f.rebtotal) as overall_avg_rebate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), combo_stats AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, AVG(f.rebtotal) as avg_rebate, AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / f.feerate) as avg_relative_gap FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune) SELECT cs.orderslink, cs.ordertune, cs.avg_rebate, cs.avg_relative_gap, cs.avg_rebate - oa.overall_avg_rebate as margin_above_avg FROM combo_stats cs, overall_avg oa WHERE cs.avg_rebate > oa.overall_avg_rebate ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
